_note: The companions' bought parts (round 31), on top of the kit's library. From web searches of 2026-10-18 (search-result snippets of retailers' and makers' pages; the pages could not be opened from this environment): confirm every figure and price on the maker's datasheet or the retailer's page before ordering. Prices in US dollars; a price in pounds is converted at about 1.33 and marked so. `estimate: true` is a price guessed from like parts, not a listing.

rega-rb330.model: RB330 tonearm (9 in, Rega geometry: 222 mm from the platter's centre to the arm's hole, effective length 236.5, overhang 14.5, offset 21.55 deg), with its own lead and cueing lift
rega-rb330.supplier: Safe and Sound HQ (US); Home Cinema Solutions $698
rega-rb330.note: the mounting hole and the plinth thickness it takes are in Rega's RB330 manual (arm mounting data; https://phonophono.de/mwdownloads/download/link/id/921), not read: confirm the 24 hole and the 40 mm of acrylic under its nut, or counterbore from below

ortofon-2m-black.model: 2M Black moving-magnet cartridge (nude Shibata stylus), black body, 1/2 in mount
ortofon-2m-black.note: black so it reads as a part in every colour (the lead session, round 31: the 2M Blue's blue read as a stray accent); moving magnet, so any phono stage; the 2M Red (red body) could ride on Ember

rega-24v-motor.model: 24 V low-vibration synchronous motor upgrade kit (motor, its board and mounting), for the Neo PSU
rega-24v-motor.note: the motor's size and shaft are not published in what was read: the pod's bore (56) and the pulley's bore wait on the motor in hand; sold through Rega dealers

rega-neo-psu-mk2.model: Neo PSU MK2: DSP-generated drive for Rega's 24 V motor, 33/45 by a button, fine speed trim (0.01 rpm steps) on the back; US 60 Hz 115-120 V version
rega-neo-psu-mk2.note: the speed changes without moving the belt, so the pulley has one diameter; the box stands beside the record player (or under it, on the shelf)

flat-belt.model: Flat turntable belt, ground rubber or polyurethane, 5 wide x 0.6, about 975 long unstretched (1025 round the platter's rim and the 40 pulley, stretched 5 %)
flat-belt.supplier: a turntable belt maker (cut to length)

bearing-bushes.model: Oil-impregnated sintered bronze plain bushes 10 x 14 x 12, a pair (Oilite kind), reamed to a 0.01 running fit on the spindle after pressing

carbide-ball.model: Tungsten carbide ball, 6 mm, grade 10: the spindle's thrust point, seated in a cup at the spindle's foot

thrust-pad.model: Thrust pad, PTFE (or PEEK), 13.8 x 2, at the bottom of the housing's bore, under the ball

bearing-oil.model: Turntable bearing oil, 8 ml (a light synthetic oil, ISO VG 32 or as the bush maker says)

sorbothane-feet.model: Sorbothane hemispheres or discs, 44 across, 6 tall, Shore 50 or 70 (chosen by the loaded weight, about 2 kg a foot), a set of 3, bonded under the plinth's feet

sorbothane-pod.model: Sorbothane discs 25 x 6, Shore 30, a set of 3, under the motor's pod (about 0.6 kg on them: soft, so the motor's hum stays in the pod)

feet-studs.model: Three M8 brass threaded inserts bonded with epoxy into the plinth's bottom sheet (12.5 holes, 15 deep), three M8 x 30 brass studs and lock nuts: the feet turn on them to level the platter

bearing-fixings.model: Three M4 brass threaded inserts bonded with epoxy into 6 holes in the pocket's floor, three M4 x 10 black socket button heads: the bearing's flange

acrylic-cement-small.model: Two-part polymerising acrylic cement for cast sheet (Acrifix 1R 0192 kind), clear: the cemented layers (a 100 g kit does one piece)

laser-etch-small.model: Laser etching into the cast acrylic, frosted, about 0.1 deep, from a vector file: EARF 44 wide, the etch filled with the colour, deeper
laser-etch-small.supplier: a laser-cutting shop with an engraver

centric-warm-strip.model: CENTRIC WARM LED strip, 24 V, 95+ CRI, 2700 K at full and dimming warmer toward 2000 K (PN 3008.27), 450 lm a foot; 0.40 m a lamp (two turns round the hub, 64 across, cut at its marks)
centric-warm-strip.supplier: Waveform Lighting (US), sold by the reel
centric-warm-strip.note: datasheet CS_3008.27 (https://store.waveformlighting.com/cdn/shop/files/CS_3008.27.pdf): its watts a foot and its cut length not read; about 620 lm a lamp at full; the reel price not seen (the FilmGrade 16 ft reel is $109)

rotary-dimmer.model: Single Color Mini Rotary Dimmer, 12-24 V DC PWM, with an on/off switch at the end of its turn, 2.1 mm plug in; its board taken out of the housing and screwed into the foot's pocket, the knob replaced by the acrylic one
rotary-dimmer.note: not a listed part once out of its housing: for sale, a listed 24 V dimmer to fit the same pocket (an open question)

meanwell-gst25u24.model: GST25U24-P1J wall-plug adapter, 24 V DC 1.04 A (25 W), level VI, its 2.1 mm plug on a 1.5 m lead; limited power source by one listing
meanwell-gst25u24.note: price not shown in what was read; the desktop GST25A24-P1J is $19.42 at IBS Electronics

clear-cord.model: 18/2 SPT-2 lamp cord, clear (80-2374), 8 ft: from the foot's back to a 2.1 mm in-line DC socket for the adapter, and on up the stem to the hub (low voltage only)

dc-socket.model: In-line 2.1 x 5.5 mm DC socket with strain relief, for the cord's end

cord-grip.model: Clear nylon strain-relief bush for 18/2 SPT-2 cord in a 9.5 hole (Heyco kind)

bumpons-clear.model: Bumpon SJ5302 clear hemispherical bumpers 11 x 5, a set of 6 (under the foot)

lamp-fixings.model: The lamp's screws: three M4 x 12 black button heads and M4 brass inserts bonded in the hub's flange (the shade's collar), four M3 x 8 and inserts (the foot's cover), two M3 x 6 (the dimmer's board), black nylon washers

thermal-tape.model: The strip's own adhesive on the hub, and 3M 8810 thermally conductive tape at the hub's bore round the cord's exit

felt-pad-ring.model: Silicone ring gasket 1 mm, cut to the shade's collar (68 x 92), so the formed collar is clamped without stress

_moon: Moon, the bar lamps (round 32): a cordless table lamp and a pendant

moon-battery.model: INR18650-35E Li-ion cells, 3,500 mAh, two in parallel in a welded pack with its own protection board and an NTC (7.0 Ah at 3.6 V: about 25 Wh, 12 h at the 2 W bar setting)
moon-battery.supplier: a battery pack assembler (two cells about $5 each)
moon-battery.note: UN38.3 for shipping; IEC 62133 for the pack

moon-board.model: The table lamp's board: a USB-C and pogo-pin charger (TI BQ25895 kind), a capacitive touch dimmer on the brass finial (stepless, 2200 to 2700 K warm-dim mixing two LED channels), a low-battery blink, sealed in the foot's pocket

moon-led-table.model: A 30 mm round warm-dim LED board, two channels (2200 K and 2700 K, CRI 90+), about 2.5 W at full, 200 lm; a second 4-LED ring at the column's foot to light the column (0.3 W)

moon-contacts.model: Two gold-plated spring-loaded contact pins in the tray, two flat gold rings in the foot's underside, and a 5 V tray of six (the staff's charging tray, its own product)

moon-seals.model: Two EPDM O-rings (the column in the foot, the hub's lid), a silicone foot ring 110 x 3 (Shore 40, non-slip, wipeable), a USB-C port with a rubber plug: IP44

moon-driver.model: PCD-16-700B, constant current 700 mA, 16 to 24 V, phase-cut dimmable (TRIAC, leading and trailing edge: confirm leading), UL8750 Class 2, 84 x 57 x 29.5: in the canopy

moon-cob.model: Vero SE 10 COB, 2700 K, CRI 90, about 1,100 lm at 700 mA (confirm its forward voltage sits in the driver's 16 to 24 V), with an Ideal Chip-Lok holder, in the brass hub on its own heat sink

moon-cord.model: Black textile-braided 3-core 0.75 mm2 pendant cord, 3 m (cut to the drop), a cord grip in the canopy and a strain relief in the cap, and a mounting strap for a 4 in junction box

moon-listing.model: Listing the pendant to UL 1598 (and the table lamp's battery and charger to UL 153 / IEC 62368): a one-off cost a design, spread over the first run
moon-listing.note: quoted per design; about $8,000 to $15,000 is typical for a fixture, not confirmed

_crystal: round 32d (crystal.py): the Dome pendant's bayonet and the Orb's seat; the rest is Moon's (moon-*). Estimates, to confirm.

dome-pins.model: Three stainless dowel pins 4 x 8 (ISO 8734), pressed into the hub: the bayonet's pins

dome-plunger.model: A stainless ball spring plunger M5, light force (about 10 N), threaded into the hub: the bayonet's detent, clicking into a dimple in the collar

orb-seat.model: A silicone seat ring 92 x 84 x 1.5 (Shore 40, black) in the base's cup: the ball rests on it, and it stops a nudge rolling it

_coin: EARFcoin (round 33, coin.py): the shop's work on each coin, and the set's box and the column's feet. Every price is an estimate from like jobs (laser and CNC shop rates of about $90 to $120 an hour, 2026), not a quote; coin.py costs() shows the sums at 500, 1,000 and 5,000.

coin-laser.maker: a laser shop (a CO2 laser, 100 W or more)
coin-laser.model: Laser work on one coin at about 1,000: cut from 6 mm cast sheet (125 mm of cut, about 12 s), the globe engraved into the back face, mirrored (about 20 s), and the words into the front (about 10 s), each face run in a jig from the sheet's own skeleton

coin-edge.model: The edge on one coin at about 1,000: both arrises rounded 1.5 with a roundover cutter and 100 reeds milled across it, in a vacuum fixture of 24 (about 40 s a coin)

coin-polish.maker: the CNC shop, or a tumbling finisher
coin-polish.model: Polishing one coin's edge: vapour polishing after the CNC, the faces still masked (tumbling would strip the masking, a flame can craze it); the faces are the sheet's own cast faces

coin-box.model: The set's box: a slide-lid box of 3 mm Smoke cast acrylic, 190 x 40 x 52 outside, with a felt-lined insert of eight 41 mm slots, so the coins stand on edge in spectrum order

column-feet.model: Four clear polyurethane bumpers, 10 x 2, under the column's base

coin-fill.model: Paint-filling one coin's engravings through the laser's masking: the back's globe flooded black (Smoke's white), the front's words white, scraped flush and dried before the masking is peeled (a lacquer or acrylic enamel for acrylic, e.g. One Shot lettering enamel)

column-led.maker: any (a COB or SMD round board)
column-led.model: A 44 mm round LED board, 2700 K, CRI 90, about 1.5 W at 5 V (USB), with its constant-current driver on the board

column-cable.model: A 2 m USB-C to bare-lead cable with an inline rotary dimmer, black, and a 5 V 2 A USB-C adapter

globe-uv-ring.model: A ring of twelve 395 nm UV-A LEDs (3528 SMD, about 1 W in all) on an aluminium PCB 48-62 mm, 5 V via a constant-current driver, with a touch dimmer and a USB-C socket; set below the base's rim so nobody looks into it
globe-uv-ring.supplier: AliExpress or a PCB house (JLCPCB assembly)
globe-uv-ring.note: an IEC 62471 photobiological assessment is needed before sale (expected Exempt or RG1 at this power)

globe-glow.model: (the render's stand-in for the fluorescent edge glow: nothing to buy)

globe-chip.model: (the render's hue-check chips: nothing to buy)

_crystal_32f: round 32f (crystal.py): the Orb plug-in over USB-C with an optional battery cartridge. Estimates, to confirm.

orb-board.model: The Orb's board: a USB-C PD sink (9 V, 20 W class; STUSB4500 kind), the LED driver (two channels, 2200 and 2700 K warm-dim, about 2.5 W), the capacitive touch dimmer on the anodised ring, and the cartridge's port (5 pogo pins: power, its fuel gauge on I2C) with its charger (TI BQ25895 kind), sealed in the base

orb-seals.model: Two EPDM O-rings (the window, the chassis to the drum), a silicone foot ring 110 x 2 (Shore 40, non-slip), a sealed USB-C receptacle (IP67 rated, e.g. GCT USB4135 kind): IP44

orb-cable.model: A slim black braided-fabric USB-C to USB-C cable, 2 m, 3 A, a black right-angle overmoulded plug for the notch

orb-adapter.model: A 20 W USB-C PD wall adapter, black, UL 62368-1 / CE listed (bought listed, so the plug-in Orb is a low-voltage lamp)

orb-cartridge.model: The battery cartridge: one Li-ion pouch cell about 8 x 60 x 90 (6,000 mAh at 3.7 V, about 22 Wh), its protection board and fuel gauge, in a black polished acrylic and PC housing 93 x 83 x 11 with its back face the drum's; two magnets and a detent hold it; IEC 62133-2, UN38.3 on the cartridge alone

orb-pads.model: Two gold-plated flat pads under the cartridge, for the staff tray's spring pins

_turntable_float: Float, the record player (round 34): parts added on top of Cumulus's, from web searches of 2026-10-22 (search snippets; confirm on the page before ordering)

float-bushings.model: Sorbothane vibration isolation bushings, 30 duro, 0.28 in ID x 0.72 in OD x 0.22 in thick (7.1 x 18.3 x 5.6), a 12-pack: two at each post (eight), one over and one under the base on the M6 bolt; about 1.8 kg on each (77 kPa), so the plinth sits at roughly 15-20 Hz, under the arm and cartridge's 10 Hz only by a factor of two: confirm on the maker's load chart and by a tap test

float-bolts.model: Four M6 x 70 stainless socket cap bolts, four 18 mm stainless washers, four M6 nyloc nuts (the float's hold-downs, snug only)

levelling-feet.model: Four levelling feet, M6 x 20 stud, 30 mm base with an anti-slip rubber pad, the stud into M6 brass inserts bonded into the base

cover-hinges.model: Replacement dust cover hinge for Debut series (rp-611), two: friction hinges that hold the lid open at any angle, a spring blade clamped to the lid's back wall, the foot in a slot (here a pocket in an acrylic block on the plinth's back edge)
cover-hinges.supplier: Turntable Lab ($16.95 each; listed as coming soon)
cover-hinges.note: Debut lids are about 3-4 mm and weigh about 1.2 kg; ours is 6 mm and about 2.9 kg: confirm the hinges' torque holds it, or take Technics-pattern hinges (2-pack $15.99) and add a counterspring

led-strip-float.model: LCLS24V-24W-27K-IP22: 24 V, 4.8 W/m, 8 mm, 2700 K, CRI 90+, dimmable, 5 m roll (1.42 m used, in four straight runs standing in the base's slot, facing out)
led-strip-float.note: CRI 90+, not 95: the colour seen is the tint's, but if 95 is wanted, Waveform's CENTRIC WARM is 95+ at about three times the power a metre, which this slot would not take at full (see the heat note)

led-adapter-float.model: GST25A24-P1J desktop adapter, 24 V DC 1.04 A (25 W), level VI, IEC C8 inlet, 2.1 mm plug; UL/cUL 62368-1 listed, a Class 2 / limited power source (the strip draws 6.8 W)

float-dimmer.model: Single Color Mini Rotary Dimmer, 12-24 V DC PWM, in its own housing, in line on the 24 V lead behind the record player (2.1 mm in and out), on/off at the end of its turn

float-fixings.model: Brass threaded inserts (4 M6 for the feet, 4 M6 for the posts' bolts, 4 M4 for the hinge blocks, 3 M4 for the bearing's flange), M4 stainless button screws, two clear Heyco-kind cord grips (motor and light), 3M Bumpon SJ5302 clear x 6 under the lid's walls

pod-bushings.model: Sorbothane bushings, 30 duro, 7.1 x 18.3 x 5.6 (the float's, from a second 12-pack): three stacks of two under the motor's pod, 2.2 kg on three, 32 kPa a stack (load per the maker's table UNCONFIRMED)

bearing-bushes-solid.model: Two solid bronze plain bushes (C932 / SAE 660), 10 x 14 x 12, pressed into the housing and honed in line to the ground spindle, 3-5 um diametral clearance

thrust-plate.model: Thrust plate 13.8 x 3, hardened 52100 steel (60 HRC) lapped flat, at the foot of the housing's bore in the oil bath, under the carbide ball (a sapphire window of the same size is the alternative)
thrust-plate.supplier: a bearing supplier or the lathe shop

float-dimmer-hf.model: FilmGrade Flicker-Free LED Dimmer, part 3081, 6-60 V DC, 10 A, turn dial, in line on the 24 V lead; PWM at 25 kHz (Waveform's knowledge base; the store page says flicker-free 0-100 %), above anything a phono stage hears
float-dimmer-hf.note: confirm the PWM frequency on its datasheet; Moss LED's MiniCine V2 (selectable to 32 kHz) is the alternative

float-earth.model: An M3 ring tag on the bearing housing's flange and 0.5 mm2 green-yellow wire to the arm's earth lead

acrylic-cement-2r.model: ACRIFIX 2R 0190, two-component polymerising cement for cast acrylic (cures through any tint, unlike the one-part light-curing 1R 0192); Weld-On 40 or 42 is the US equivalent

slot-mask-print.model: Opaque black band screen-printed in two coats (UV-curing ink for acrylic) on the base's top over the light's slot: four runs, 9 wide, 1.36 m in all; black cast acrylic strips cemented in a shallow rebate are the alternative
